message.content: In one of the conversations, Thrall mentioned the importance of supporting local businesses alongside the garden project. Specifically, Thrall stated, "Looks like we're all on the same page about this project! Keep sharing your thoughts, everyone! Can't wait to see the combined efforts of our garden and local businesses shine! 🌼🌍". This indicates that Thrall suggested creating a space within the garden that highlights and promotes local businesses. However, no specific details were provided about what exactly was to be created to support local businesses.
